notes: Adds open-ended asbestos historical bulk import and a searchable Source Library. Any number of PDFs can be selected; files are processed sequentially to protect browser memory, with 50 MB per-file validation, duplicate skipping, automatic type/date/version pre-detection, progress, failure isolation and no automatic publication. The Source Library supports search/type/year/status filters, oldest/newest sorting, 20-per-page pagination, Review, Open full report, Download PDF, re-analysis/TEST cleanup, and filtered multi-part ZIP export. No database migration required.
